technical.summary: ABT shows long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, Ichimoku) with rising RSI momentum, but near-term price weakness below key moving averages, oversold stochastic, and weak trend strength (ADX 23) suggest waiting for confirmation before entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 62 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for directional conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish 39.7% vs bullish 22.9%) with greed reading provides neutral backdrop; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (143), strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings in 62 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, Ichimoku above cloud, supertrend bullish) with rising RSI provides directional tailwind for patient swing traders willing to wait for near-term confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), weak trend strength (ADX 23), price below key moving averages (EMA 9/21/20), oversold stochastic (K 16.58), negative CMF, and zero fundamental/smart money support make entry premature and high-risk.
